units.source_scale_reason: Reviewed source-resolution registration; one anatomical scale per original image.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The walk, attack, cast and death are steady-light retakes because their first takes darkened the plate in long stretches. The walk glides through one cycle looped over 59-117, the bite lunges with open jaws, the baying cast raises the head and holds, and the death sinks onto the belly and settles flat. The defend hunkers down and holds; it ends at 55, before the hound rises back up against its prompt. The idle and hit are used as generated.
